messages:
Alex: Quick sync: Q4 launches + BF surge — need updated GPU-hour forecast and cross-region fallback plan. Who can run numbers?
Maria: I can run sims, need traffic profile and latency SLOs. @Priya can you paste expected request curves?
Priya: Marketing will run 3 waves: Nov 20 00:00-06:00 UTC, Nov 24 14:00-18:00 UTC, Dec 2 18:00-23:59 UTC. Peak multiplier 4x baseline during windows. Also product launch on Oct 10 with 2x for 6 hrs.
Jin: Baseline perf: single A100-80GB yields ~120 tok/s at p95 under seq len 256. KV cache hit reduces cost by ~15% for conversational flows.
Leo: Cost back-of-envelope: on-demand A100 ~ $3/hr, reserved commit ~ $1.8/hr. If we need 200 GPUs for 12 peak hours across events => delta cost ~ (3-1.8)*200*12 = $2880 per event (on-demand vs reserved).
Maria: I'll run a Monte Carlo using 1000 sims. Need assumed cache hit rates (low/med/high). Can we provide those?
Jin: Use cache hit rates: low 10%, med 30%, high 55%. Also include model quantized variant (4-bit) which gains ~1.8x throughput.
Alex: Routing idea: prefer us-west-2, fallback to eu-west-1, and for overflow route to quantized model pool to protect latency SLO. Example policy:
```
routing:
  - prefer: us-west-2
    fallback: eu-west-1
    overflow_variant: quantized-4bit
    max_p99_increase_ms: 50
```
Priya: Important: EU customers must stay in-region for data residency for some accounts — we need region-specific capacity reservations for those tenants.
ops-bot: autoscaler:detected 3x spike in us-west-2 last week; scaled to 160 GPUs, cooldown 15m.
Maria: Running sims now. Quick question: do we want to model partial warm pools (e.g., 20% warm) to reduce cold-start latency?
Jin: Yes, model warm pools at 20/50/80% in sims. Cold-start penalty ~90s per GPU if container cold, but we can pre-warm models to 30s.
Leo: Also run a cost scenario for pre-warm vs no-pre-warm. Pre-warm cost = prewarm_gpus * hours * reserved_rate.
Alex: Action items:
- Maria: deliver GPU-hour projections + three cost scenarios (on-demand, reserved commit, reserved+prewarm) by EOD tomorrow.
- Jin: provide exact throughput numbers for quantized variants and cold-start multipliers (by EOD today).
- Leo: run cost sensitivity for 10/20/30% warm pool (by noon tomorrow).
- Priya: confirm exact launch windows in calendar and list residency-constrained customer IDs.
Please @ here when you upload results. :rocket:
Maria: Got it, starting runs.
Priya: I'll DM the residency list.
Alex: Thanks. If sims show >2.5x baseline sustained for any window we trigger dedicated reserved purchases and enable overflow routing.
Maria: FYI I'll attach a CSV with sim rows when done.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling update to autoscaler config applied (min_gpus=10 -> 20) at 1764801400.
Jin: Noted, I'll factor the new min into sims.
Leo: I'll also model spot availability loss (10% chance) and its cost impact.
Alex: Perfect. We'll regroup in this thread tomorrow after numbers. Keep messages short in replies here so it's searchable. :mag:
